direction: One approved Violetto timbre. Character-specific pitch range, cadence and pauses; each authored scene speed multiplies the speaker cadence. Global pitch centre stays within ±0.5 semitone. Native synthesis, no WAV time stretching.

Ren.description: Warm and conversational, lightly animated with brisk replies.

Satō.description: Formal, measured and lower-centred; deliberate teacher emphasis.

Hana.description: Bright and engaged, with a wider melodic range and short pauses.

Yui.description: Warm and forward: brighter centre, varied inflection and brisk, connected phrases.

You.description: Composed learner role: lower centre, smaller pitch range and more deliberate pauses.

Kenta.description: Ren's younger brother: brisk casual phrasing, clipped pauses and lively inflection.

Yamamoto.description: Unhurried and considerate, with gentle rises and warmly polite phrasing.

Mori.description: Concise office delivery: smaller pitch range and matter-of-fact endings.

Misaki.description: Animated manga friend: widest melodic range, quick replies and controlled energy.

Ishikawa.description: Deliberate manager delivery, lower centre and clear formal emphasis.

Tamura.description: Conversational rhythm; dialect comes from the authored text, not an invented accent.

Matsumoto.description: Reflective literary discussion: unhurried cadence and a restrained, lower centre.
